chapters.title: Full adder, one bit at a time
chapters.code:
def get_sum(a, b):
    result, carry = 0, 0
    for i in range(32):
        x, y = (a >> i) & 1, (b >> i) & 1
        result |= (x ^ y ^ carry) << i
        carry = (x & y) | (x & carry) | (y & carry)
    return result - (1 << 32) if result >> 31 else result      # to signed
